rationale.text: The html element carries lang="francais", the name of the language instead of its code. The glossary requires a code of 2 characters (ISO 639-1) or 3 characters (ISO 639-2 and later); francais is neither, so the code is not valid and the test's validity condition fails. The custom check faults it, so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: Le code de langue est valide ;
Code de 2 caractères (ISO 639-1) ou 3 caractères (ISO 639-2 et suivants) permettant d’indiquer la langue d’un document ou d’un passage de texte.
